content.label: This app blows any voice to text out the water.  It’s the best app I’ve found for my low volume soft talking self. No Siri or google gemini can compare. I can whisper and it is accurate 100% with accurate punctuation . Incredible app. I’m gonna stick with the free version because $15 a month is a little pricey. That’s my only gripe, other than that it’s an amazing amazing app
